rules.removal_policy: fragment whose documented parent is already a dataset entry (S3)
rules.addition_policy: documented parent of a dataset fragment, unambiguous and long enough (S4)
rules.unknown_policy: kept: undocumented is not proven fabricated (S2, conservative rule L2)
adjudication_policy: human pass over the unknown bucket (issue #192): a removal requires positive evidence, recorded per name; a keep stays in undocumented_unknown and gains a provenance marker
